entities.name: Noël Guéneau de Mussy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Noël-Francois-Odon Guéneau de Mussy was a French physician who was a native of Paris. He was the son of writer Philibert Guéneau de Mussy (1776–1854), and grandson to hygienist Jean Noël Hallé (1754–1822).

entities.summary: Noël-Francois-Odon Guéneau de Mussy was a French physician who was a native of Paris. He was the son of writer Philibert Guéneau de Mussy (1776–1854), and grandson to hygienist Jean Noël Hallé (1754–1822).
